# 我为什么要做自研游戏引擎 - 知识图谱

## 动机与现有引擎问题
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    UnityPricing["Unity 收费政策改变"] --> UnityDiscontent["使用 Unity 的不满"]
    UnityDiscontent --> DecisionSelfEngine["决定自研引擎"]
    UnrealComplex["Unreal 5 优化难度大"] --> DecisionSelfEngine
    UnrealBloat["Unreal 多行业使用导致臃肿"] --> DecisionSelfEngine
    MultiIndustryUse["Unreal 被影视、建筑等行业使用"] --> UnrealBloat
    LumenIssues["Lumen 渲染表现差、优化困难"] --> DecisionSelfEngine
    OptimizationDifficulty["游戏帧率难以提升"] --> UnrealComplex
```

## 技术选型架构
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    RenderingAPIChoice["渲染 API 选型"] --> DirectX12["DirectX 12 (Windows)"]
    RenderingAPIChoice --> OpenGL["OpenGL (入门)"]
    OpenGL --> FutureDX12["后期迁移至 DirectX 12"]
    LanguageChoice["脚本语言选型"] --> Lua["Lua (简易)"]
    LanguageChoice --> Cpp["C++ (性能)"]
    LanguageChoice --> Blueprint["Blueprint (可视化)"]
    LanguageChoice --> Python["Python (可选)"]
    WindowLibChoice["窗口库选型"] --> GLFW["GLFW (老旧)"]
    WindowLibChoice --> SDL["SDL (推荐)"]
    ModelImportLib["模型导入库"] --> ASSIMP["ASSIMP"]
    GuiLib["GUI 库"] --> DRMGUI["DRMGUI"]
    RenderingAPIChoice --> FutureFeatures["后续支持 Vulkan 等新特性"]
```

## 自研引擎的工具价值
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    ToolSet["完整工具集"] --> Editor["编辑器"]
    ToolSet --> SceneBuilder["场景搭建工具"]
    ToolSet --> Optimizer["性能优化工具"]
    ToolSet --> BatchProcessor["批处理脚本"]
    ReusableTools["工具可复用性"] --> SingleDevelopment["一次开发，多项目使用"]
    ReusableTools --> LongTermUse["长期维护便利"]
    SingleDevelopment --> EfficiencyGain["提升开发效率"]
    EfficiencyGain --> CostSaving["降低开发成本"]
```

## 开发路线图
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    LearnRendering["学习渲染基础"] --> ChooseOpenGL["选择 OpenGL 作为起点"]
    ChooseOpenGL --> ImplementLowLevel["实现底层渲染框架"]
    ImplementLowLevel --> SwitchToDirectX12["后期迁移至 DirectX 12"]
    ImplementLowLevel --> BuildEditor["构建编辑器界面"]
    BuildEditor --> IntegrateLua["集成 Lua 脚本系统"]
    IntegrateLua --> AddCppSupport["加入 C++ 扩展支持"]
    AddCppSupport --> AddBlueprint["实现 Blueprint 可视化"]
    AddBlueprint --> ReleaseBeta["发布 Beta 版"]
    ReleaseBeta --> IterateOptimization["持续优化与迭代"]
```
